input.note: Image defined by formula, not shipped as bytes: auditable in the diff and reproducible in any language. Per-channel gradients differ so an RGB/BGR swap changes the statistics instead of cancelling out. Size 64 rather than the model's 384 keeps the fixture reviewable; the arithmetic under test is per-pixel and size-independent.

applied.resize: identity -- input is already at the model input size, so resampling is excluded on purpose; see the module docstring
